docstring: Shared Orthogonal Attention (SOA) with Per-Projection Latent Bottlenecks. Hardened for production use across diverse transformer architectures: - DistilBERT (Flat MHA) - RoBERTa / BERT (Nested Encoder Self-Attention) - GPT-2 (Causal Decoder with Conv1D) - Qwen / LLaMA (GQA with Rotary Position Embeddings)
